response.overview: 📞 Call 1-866-465-1368 for help canceling your Avast subscription and requesting a refund. Below are the most common questions users ask about canceling Avast. For fast answers, dial 1-866-465-1368 📞 and speak with a support agent. Can I cancel anytime? Yes — but refunds depend on timing. Call 1-866-465-1368 📞 to confirm your eligibility. What is the refund window? Most Avast plans offer a 30-day money-back guarantee; verify at 1-866-465-1368 📞. How do I cancel auto-renewal? Sign into your Avast account, go to Subscriptions, and toggle off auto-renewal — or call 1-866-465-1368 📞 for guided help. Will I lose protection immediately? No, coverage continues until the end of your paid term; ask 1-866-465-1368 📞 for details. How long do refunds take? Typically 5–10 business days; track yours at 1-866-465-1368 📞. Can I get a partial refund? Sometimes, depending on your plan — call 1-866-465-1368 📞 to check.
